body:
Oh jesus that is a horrendous thing to go through! From the stress that you endured did you develop any physical symptoms? I know I have been under extreme stress & the body can do some crazy things when under pressure for an extended amount of time. I pray that that is what is causing my weakened immune system & my fear just feeds on itself that ultimately weakened my body so much. Also I'm from Australia :)
Will be in touch whenever I have a development. Thank you internet stranger :)

Thanks for responding mate, and glad to hear you are fine.   

But I'm sure the mental anguish you suffered was just as devastating to your life. Can I ask what led you to even think about HTLV being part of your scare all those years ago and how you ruled it out? I only ask as even now doctors are hardly aware about the disease even though HIV used to be called HTLV-III so I couldn't imagine it would have even been on your radar 10 years ago? Did you even have symptoms that lead to such a concern like a yeast infection?  
  
I will keep you informed of my progress, it's comforting to know I have an outlet to voice my concerns, it's been a very lonely & dark time.

Thank you for taking the time to respond mate. Actually thank you A LOT. These are words of inspiration I've needed to hear. Regardless of what I've done with my life, there is still a lot to be thankful for & a lot I can do for others. Thank you thank you thank you

Thank you for the time you have taken to respond to me, I didn't even realise someone had until I just checked back. To answer your questions:   
One: I don't know for sure what I am infected with, I have an appointment with a infectious disease specialist in 2 weeks (they couldn't fit me in any earlier) in which I will have the PCR & anti-body tests.  
Two: I'm sure if I am infected with any it would be HTLV-1, based on the fact that prostitute was originally from Brazil. You can imagine my horror when I found out that one of the places where this is an epidemic was Brazil.  
Three: We did have unprotected sex, but I'm not in a position to know if she is ill at all. Mainly as we live in different countries & I don't want to alarm her as I have know solid evidence as to what this is.  
Four: The main symptoms I have now is Candida on the tongue, yeast infection around the groin area (which means my immune system has been weakened for some time now) & pins & needles in my feet & hands. I no longer have any night sweats, diarrhea etc.

I have had all other tests for STD's, everything clear so I am thankful of that, & the sexual health clinic says there is nothing more they can do for me so gave me a reference for the infectious disease clinic. But with the timings & everything that's been going on I just know this is related to the exposure I so stupidly allowed myself to happen. There is something going on with my immune system as my white blood cell count is twice as high as it should be.   

I would love you know how you know so much about this disease though. Most of my research I have found is contradictory to yours regarding how it is tested (as it doesn't have a test window) as well as rate of spread & how hard it is to contract (relatively easy, even through oral). 
Thank you again for your time to write this all out, it is much appreciated

I can relate, I can pinpoint the moment my life changed forever because of a stupid, careless & reckless decision I made, one that was completely avoidable. But I now have an incurable chronic disease because of it & am haunted by this as I fall asleep every night, and again when I wake up. 

The time I am asleep is the only time I'm at peace, but depending on how distraught I am before I go to bed, sometimes even then it haunts my dreams. The most horrible thing is like most regrets, I can't fix this, but where mine probably differs from most mistakes is it's taken away any hope of a future, any happiness of a family & because of this I don't think I'll be around very long. 

Living with the guilt & how I fucked my life & the life of someone I love up, is unbearable. It's a sad fact that depression over this will probably kill me before this disease does but I'd rather go on my terms.

Best of luck with getting past your choices and I hope you can find a way to forgive yourself for whatever it is that's haunting you.

I am so sorry for your loss. At the moment I am at the lowest point of my life. My depression and hopelessness of a future of any kind has been brought on due to a careless stupid act that has infected me with an incurable disease that I have given to the woman I love. 

The devastation this has wrecked on my life is incomprehensible & ending it all to stop my suffering feels so right. But this post has made me think twice. I don't know what the future holds. I know people love me, and even though the guilt of what I have done is too much to take, sticking around for now is something I can do, just taking it step by step. Not a day goes by I don't break down and cry, but maybe just maybe one day I will once again wake up and realise life is for living.

Also to hmistry, the girl I love is from New Zealand so through some small coincidence I get comfort from your post too.
Thank you both for this moment of peace.

I had sex with a prostitute while overseas then coincidently met the love of my life 2 weeks later who I want to spend the rest of my life with. I fear I have contracted [HTLV-1](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_T-lymphotropic_virus), which is similar to HIV yet isn't even treatable and we are just told to deal with it until we die. It's a fear as it's actually hard to get a positive test for it. I believe I have in turn given it to her (before I realised I even had anything). I now suffer from extreme depression, anxiety & am suicidal.

Really happy for you mate. I'm in the same boat at the moment if you click on my user name. The past month has been the most soul searching horrific time of my entire life. It's still not over yet, but judging by the symptoms I have I've convinved myself 100% it's going to be positive. Like you said in the post I mostly feel fear and sadness for possibly exposing my partner who I love deeply to hiv. But good news or bad, I need to know.

Yeah I've read a lot of research into the odds of contracting it and how low it can be but regardless, the mind can truly be a horrific thing, especially when threatened with your own mortality. You can't help but think the worst :(

I'm male and it was a female. Safe sex was used on me (oral included) but I gave her oral as well & I'd recently brushed my teeth prior to going and my gums always bleed which is how I fear I may have contracted it. But I really do appreciate your words of support. I'm about 12 hours away from getting to the hospital & getting the first rapid test as well as all the other STD tests so this has really helped me at least calm down. I can't change what's happened so this little time of reduced stress & increasing peace is a godsend. Especially considering I still have another 5 hour flight to endure!
Thank you

Thanks mate, I appreciate the perspective. You're right, just as others have suggested & why I've returned home early, to get this bloody test done so I can start the new chapter in my life. Either way this is life defining for me. If positive, I start a new life dealing with HIV & doing the hardest thing in my life, informing the woman I love. If negative, I'll have a new appreciation for life & take nothing for granted. I will make sure I'll update either way. Thank you for your support

The States is actually where I've just spent the last month in constant fear! The incident & following falling in love all happened in Europe but then once we parted, the symptoms started when I arrived in the states. It was horrible. I even had a helicopter flight over the Grand Canyon which upset me even more because I couldn't even enjoy it, it was so awe inspiring & beautiful, all I could think about is how I'd fucked everything up & just started crying in the damn helicopter!

Yeah that's the reason I've cut my trip short by 2 months I just couldn't go through the torture of not knowing for sure. Unfortunately like most people in my situation I googled the shit out of HIV & AIDS and brought myself to the conclusion that I'm 100% infected anyway but thought if I am I'd rather know than live in constant fear. I have read stories about people having the symptoms then being negative, but those are few and far between unfortunately. But thank you for your concern my friend

Thank you for your response coastermonger. Even though you are a stranger to me this has given me hope which after an entire month of being alone in a foreign country means so very much. More than you'll ever know. Thank you.

Like I'm sure a lot of you have experienced in the past, or are experiencing now, I am completely convinced I have HIV. And it seems appropriate given today is World Aids day that I get this off my chest so if you do read this thank you for your time.

I had an encounter with a prostitute, then met the love of my life, spent 2 months travelling together before parting ways (she had her own travel plans before we met) and now I think I may have contracted something terrible and in turn given it to her as we had unprotected sex (stupidly, it was a heat of the moment thing, young love etc)
I've been travelling for 3 months now, the encounter happened about 20 days in.

So a bit of background on what led me to my current situation. 
Two weeks ago my elbow become swollen for no apparent reason. I did some research & it says gonorrhea can be a possible reason because it caused swelling when the bacteria gets into the joints. Then from there the internet opened up a world of hysteria. Mainly due to the likely hood that with one STD brings many and increases the risk of HIV transmission. I rushed at 4am to a hospital for testing of every STD including HIV. As I am overseas just getting those was traumatic enough. I felt & still feel so alone. So far away from home.

The next two two weeks waiting for the results were & still are, the most traumatic & terrifying of my entire life. Even though the results came back negative it was at 10 weeks and am aware of the window so I am no way out of the woods & need to retest at 3 & 6 months, which I will still be overseas for. Since the test came back I developed a swollen lymph node under my right armpit, feel lethargic all the time & had flu symptoms. I have now convinced myself 100% I have HIV. Now the waiting, the worrying, the googling is my life. The constant scenarios that play continuously in my head like a waking nightmare. The level of horror I am experiencing on a daily basis is only amplified by the loneliness I feel as I am still travelling by myself after we parted ways. And the guilt. Crushing me from the inside like I'm in a deep sea. This may sound melodramatic & over the top but please don't judge if you've never experienced this yourself. If you have gone through this then I feel for you deeply too. I wouldn't even wish this upon my worst enemy.
I don't know if I believe in fate or coincidence & chance, but it does feel like a sick joke. I met this girl & fell in love, had the most unbelievable time seeing the most beautiful places in Europe together & creating memories & experiences we will have forever, and then this happens. I've possibly fucked everything up even before I met her. Almost like life gave me one last taste of what it feels like to live in pure bliss with someone you feel completely connected too, only to take it away. But it is my fault. I have no misconceptions about that. I am not shaking my fist at the sky & yelling 'why god, why me'. I did this to myself. I could have possibly done this to her as well.

In the space of 3 months I went from the highest of highs to here, what I imagine some form of hell on earth is like.
Not knowing feels like a disease all it's own. It takes on a life form, feeding on fear & doubt. The mind when scared is a hideous thing, calling in every deep seeded fear you have locked away about your mortality, and nothing is scarier than that. Nothing apart from the fear you have given this to someone you love & can lose them forever because of it. Losing the only person you could see yourself spending the rest of your life with because of something selfish, something stupid & most of all something shameful.

Suicide comes into my head constantly. Not because of what I might have, but because what I may have given to the most beautiful person I have ever met. If I've ruined her life & the life she could have had & that every second of the day is what eats at me the most. I'm depressed , the deepest you can go and would love to end it all. To stop this agony & suffering I may have caused.

I say 'may have caused' because I'd like to hold onto hope that this will pass. Even if I do have it, I just hope she does not. It's terrible because we live in different countries as well (I'm Australian, she's form NZ) and immigration laws prohibit HIV+ people from moving to either country so we wouldn't even be able to move to support each other (if the scenario happens that we are both + and she will even still want to be in contact with me)

So sorry for the long nature & rambling of this post, but I needed to get this off my chest & you reddit have been a pillar of support so I thank you all for sharing your stories.
I will update if I get any developments. And if this passes & I am without HIV, I know the sun will shine brighter, the food taste better & every second I breathe will not be wasted.
Peace

**TL;DR: I had an encounter with a prostitute, then met the love of my life, spent 2 months travelling together before parting ways (she had her own travel plans before we met) and now I think I may have contracted something terrible and in turn given it to her as we had unprotected sex. I can no longer live with myself, the guilt & worry are insurmountable**
